text: Alright the next slice is, so there is the cart/modelview.tsx which was the incubation for the remake of the studio. what needs to happen is this, for starters, when clicking on a model in the content browser i want to see a new tab open up, the model loaded into this viewer
resolution: Resolved by turning model packages with real viewer-loadable source paths into document-tab targets: ModelView now accepts an initial path/title for embedding, the editor model document surface renders that viewer for file-backed model packages, and the hmsc-int catalog exposes existing .glb/.obj data from imported props plus loose source model files such as Desk.glb and car.obj. Existing Studio snapshot documents still open StudioEditor, while cooked/indexed records remain on the metadata surface until a host loader exists for cooked mesh blobs. Verified with SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship editor.
